coverage.description: All 67 selected airports have generated scenario inputs; this is not verified quotation coverage.

geographySource.boundary: Coordinates only. No fuel price, supply capacity or flight performance is observed.

commonBase.en: USD 800/t is a normalization for experiments. The fuel-only optimizer responds to price ratios; multiplying all prices by the same positive factor scales cost without changing feasible fuel quantities. Changing only the common base keeps add-ons fixed, changes price ratios and can change the preferred plan.
commonBase.zh: 800 美元/吨是实验归一化基准。仅以燃油成本为目标时，决策取决于价格比；所有价格同乘一个正数会同比改变成本，不改变可行油量。仅调整基础价会保留其他差价，因而改变价格比和可能的最优方案。

regionalSpread.en: Starting regional bases span −8.75% to +18.75% of the common base; service allowances span 5% to 10.625%. These deliberately exercise price spreads above and below carriage hurdles, rather than estimate observed regional price rankings.
regionalSpread.zh: 初始区域差价覆盖基础价的 −8.75% 至 +18.75%，服务费覆盖 5% 至 10.625%。这样可测试低于和高于携油成本门槛的价差，并非估计真实地区价格排名。

transport.en: The starting coefficient 0.015 USD/t/km adds USD 15/t for each 1,000 km of reference distance: 1.875% of the default base. This linear sensitivity rule is replaced by actual routing and tariffs when available.
transport.zh: 初始系数 0.015 美元/吨/公里意味着参照距离每增加 1,000 公里，成本增加 15 美元/吨，即默认基础价的 1.875%。取得实际路径与运价后应替换这条线性敏感性规则。

supply.en: The starting common 120 t/visit cap exceeds the generic widebody tank of 110 t, so unexplained airport bottlenecks do not drive the default result. Lower caps create explicit supply-stress experiments.
supply.zh: 初始统一的 120 吨/次供油上限高于通用宽体机的 110 吨油箱容量，使默认结果不受无依据的机场瓶颈主导。下调上限可构建明确的供应压力实验。

profiles.en: Starting generic-profile masses deliberately leave different tank, takeoff and landing headroom. Widebody zero-fuel mass is 150 t, leaving 90 t at takeoff and 40 t at landing; narrowbody zero-fuel mass is 54 t, leaving 25 t and 13 t. These are coherent teaching assumptions, not aircraft calibration.
profiles.zh: 初始通用机型质量参数保留不同的油箱、起飞与落地余量：宽体机无油重量 150 吨，起飞与落地余量为 90 吨和 40 吨；窄体机为 54 吨，余量为 25 吨和 13 吨。这是内部一致的实验假设，不是机型校准。

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Dated licensed jet-fuel assessment; a public EIA wholesale series is context, not an airport offer.
assumptionCatalog.formula: Analyst normalization, default 800; not fitted to a current price.

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Supplier contract differential for the same product, period, unit and delivery basis.
Verified refinery/terminal supply chain and transport origin.
assumptionCatalog.formula: Editorial regional assignment, not an observed supply relationship.

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Actual freight, pipeline or road tariff and delivered routing.
assumptionCatalog.formula: Transport proxy = great-circle hub distance × coefficient.

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Dated into-plane handling and delivery fee schedule.
Applicable exemption/tax evidence for the operator and mission.
assumptionCatalog.formula: Default 0 is an assumption, not a tax-exemption claim.

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Confirmed supplier allocation for the specific uplift window.
assumptionCatalog.formula: Flat default 120 for every airport; not stock or daily throughput.

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Planned operational flight path or observed trajectory.
Operator-approved performance with winds and routing.
Operator performance/flight-planning fuel calculations.
Operator climb/descent profile and route-specific time.
Operator climb/descent fuel calculation.
Departure airport and aircraft-specific taxi/APU plan.
Applicable operator fuel policy; this is not a regulatory minimum.
Applicable operator reserve policy and planned holding requirements.
Aircraft performance at the planned holding conditions.
Actual alternate route and operator-approved fuel plan.
Operator-approved required arrival fuel; no regulatory equivalence is claimed.
Aircraft-specific marginal-weight fuel response.
assumptionCatalog.note: ICAO discusses a 2.5–4.5%/h indicative range. The selected profile value and retention law are analyst assumptions, not aircraft calibration.

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Validated operator performance model.
assumptionCatalog.formula: Loss = k × time (linear) or 1 − exp(−k × time) (exponential).

assumptionCatalog.replacementSource: Aircraft-specific operating-empty weight and crew/equipment definition.
Approved passenger/cargo/load plan.
Aircraft usable fuel capacity using the applicable fuel density.
Flight-specific certified and runway/performance-limited takeoff mass.
Flight-specific certified and operational landing mass.
Measured departure inventory / previous-leg remaining fuel.
Validated lower limit of the selected aircraft performance approximation.
Payload-dependent flight planning and validated model scope; not published aircraft range.
Validated time envelope for the selected performance approximation.
